mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the 20-day periods following a month with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past three months signals an emerging economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 5-day periods following a 3-month UNRATE increase > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 275) and a stable or declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS change < 0.1% in the past month) signals an unsustainable accommodative monetary policy in the face of rising inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 20-day periods following a period where CPIAUCSL > 275 and FEDFUNDS change < 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions, characterized by high consumer spending (RSAFS) and robust housing starts (HOUST), the S&P 500 tends to experience negative returns over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation and anticipation of monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 60-day periods when RSAFS and HOUST are both above their 5-year moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, as indicated by high monthly job gains (PAYEMS above 150,000), consistently predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the 20-day periods following a month with PAYEMS above 150,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 5-day periods following a month with INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 1.5% annualized) and declining housing starts (HOUST < 1500) signals an economic deceleration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the 20-day periods following a period with GDPC1 growth rate < 1.5% and HOUST < 1500.

mechanism_narrative: In the aftermath of a financial shock (defined by UNRATE rising > 0.5pp and INDPRO falling > 1.0% in the past month), the S&P 500 experiences positive returns over the next 60 trading days due to monetary policy easing and market stabilization.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the 60-day periods following a shock event (UNRATE rise > 0.5pp and INDPRO fall > 1.0% in the past month).
